title: Community Seed Library Catalogue Backend Development
originalRequest: Set up the database and basic search features for the community seed library catalogue.
latestMessage: Set up the database and basic search features for the community seed library catalogue.

steps.title: Implement seed taxonomy schema and search filters
steps.instruction: Design and apply the database schema for indexing seeds by botanical family, planting season, and sun requirements. Implement a backend query service to filter catalogue items based on these attributes.
steps.acceptance: Database migrations execute without errors, and the query service returns correct seed records matching the filter criteria in integration tests.
steps.result: I have created and applied the PostgreSQL migration schema for the `seed_varieties` and `growth_requirements` tables. Currently implementing the query builder logic in the search service to handle compound filters (season + sun exposure). Basic unit tests for the botanical family filter are passing, and I am now expanding test coverage to seasonal filters.
